n1.speaker: player
n1.text: (A fox-eared streamer corners you outside a fresh gate line, camera already rolling.)

n2.speaker: kess
n2.text: You're the landlord who took in a Warden? Perfect. I need content, you need rent. Let's talk.

n3.speaker: player
n3.text: (Somehow, by the end of the conversation, she has a room.)
